content.title: How to watch WrestleMania 42: WWE live streams, TV channels and preview
content.text: (Image credit: Meg Oliphant/WWE via Getty Images) Watch WrestleMania 42 on ESPN Unlimited (US) / Netflix (RoW)Unlock your stream with Norton VPNWrestleMania 2026: Sat, Apr 18 – Sun, Apr 19 (full schedule below) John Cena is making his WWE return at WrestleMania 42, albeit in a hosting capacity, but with Gunther – the man who retired him in December – on the card, we can't help but wonder if things could escalate. The Austrian, who hasn't stopped gloating, has since retired AJ Styles and started a beef with Seth Rollins, who he'll face on Night 1. Sunday's action at Allegiant Stadium begins with a blockbuster meeting between Brock Lesnar and Oba Femi. The former two-time NXT Champion memorably took The Beast down at Raw, after Lesnar eliminated him at Royal Rumble.The World Heavyweight Championship showdown between CM Punk and Roman Reigns will bring the curtain down on the Showcase of the Immortals. The former WWE Universal Champion earned his shot at the title with victory at Royal Rumble, but has come across as a little bit desperate with his criticisms of CM Punk, which amount to disrespecting the brand. Nobody likes a suck-up.The most daunting task of the weekend, however, no doubt lies at the feet of Cody Rhodes, the current Undisputed WWE Championship title holder. He's putting his belt on the line against Randy Orton, in order to kick Pat McAfee's big mouth out of wrestling for good.Here's where to watch WrestleMania 42 live streams online from anywhere (and even for free). Scroll down for the full WrestleMania 42 card. How to watch any WrestleMania 42 stream using a VPNHow to watch WrestleMania 42 live streams in the US In the US, WrestleMania 42 is being shown on ESPN Unlimited.A subscription costs $29.99 per month or $299.99 per year, and includes coverage of all WWE Premium Live Events, NFL, NHL, NBA, soccer from Spain and Germany, ESPN Originals, 30 for 30s and more.The first hour of Night 1 is also being shown on ESPN2, with the first hour of Night 2 available to watch on ESPN.Both channels are carried by Sling TV, Fubo TV, YouTube TV, Hulu+Live TV, and DirecTV Stream.Outside the US for WrestleMania 42? Use Norton VPN to access your usual streams. How to watch WrestleMania 42 live streams in the Rest of the World Netflix is showing WrestleMania 42 outside the US, including in Canada, the UK and Australia.A subscription to Netflix starts at CA$7.99 / £7.99 / AU$9.99 per month.There's a huge collection of past WWE shows to stream on the service or, for something fresh, discover the best new Netflix movies with our dedicated guide.Use Norton VPN to watch Netflix wherever you are in the world if you find your WWE access blocked. Can I watch WrestleMania 42 for free?The first hour of Night 1 is being shown on ESPN2 and the first hour of Night 2 on ESPN, both of which are available through the YouTube TV 10-day free trial.WrestleMania 42 is being shown on Abema in Japan, which has made WWE events available to watch for free in the past. What is the WrestleMania 42 schedule?Saturday, April 186pm – WrestleMania 42 Night 1Sunday, April 196pm – WrestleMania 42 Night 2(All times ET) What is the WrestleMania 42 card?Saturday, April 18The Vision (Logan Paul & Austin Theory) & IShowSpeed (with Paul Heyman) vs The Usos (Jey Uso & Jimmy Uso) & LA Knight – Six-man tag team matchJacob Fatu vs Drew McIntyreStephanie Vaquer (c) vs Liv Morgan – Singles match for Women's World ChampionshipAJ Lee (c) vs Becky Lynch – Singles match for the WWE Women's Intercontinental ChampionshipThe Irresistible Forces (Nia Jax & Lash Legend) (c) vs Charlotte Flair & Alexa Bliss vs Bayley & Lyra Valkyria vs The Bella Twins (Brie Bella & Nikki Bella) – Fatal four-way tag team match for WWE Women's Tag Team ChampionshipSeth Rollins vs Gunther – Singles matchCody Rhodes (c) vs Randy Orton (with Pat McAfee) – Singles match for Undisputed WWE ChampionshipSunday, April 19Oba Femi vs Brock Lesnar – Singles matchPenta (c) vs Je'Von Evans vs Dragon Lee vs JD McDonagh vs Rusev vs Rey Mysterio – Six-pack ladder match for WWE Intercontinental ChampionshipJade Cargill (c) vs Rhea Ripley – Singles match for WWE Women's ChampionshipSami Zayn (c) vs Trick Williams – Singles match for WWE United States Championship"The Demon" Finn Balor vs. Dominik Mysterio – Singles matchCM Punk (c) vs Roman Reigns – Singles match for World Heavyweight Championship What time does WrestleMania 42 start?WrestleMania 42 is a two-day event, with the action getting underway at 6pm ET / 3pm PT / 11pm BST on Saturday and Sunday. That's 8am AEST on Sunday and Monday. Can I watch WrestleMania 42 on my mobile?Of course, most broadcasters have streaming services that you can access through mobile apps or via your phone's browser. For example, ESPN in the US and Netflix everywhere else.You can also stay up-to-date with all key WrestleMania 42 moments on WWE's official social media channels on X/Twitter (@WWE), Instagram (@wwe), Facebook (WWE) TikTok (wwe) and YouTube (@WWE).
